entries.reading: あいざわ のぶひこ
entries.role: Student at Arai's school in Toyama
entries.note: Previously ordinary. Becomes fixated on death by jumping and treats other students as subjects in some branches. Use Nobuhiko when addressed by his given name.

entries.role: Aizawa's fellow student and confidante in some branches
entries.note: Shares his interest in death by jumping. Her motives vary with the branch, and the narrative withholds her name until the relevant reveal.

entries.reading: くわばたけ たつや
entries.note: A delinquent. The series reference supplies the reading Kuwabatake. The script's asset alias is kuwabata.
The four urban-legend enthusiasts are Hikomaro, Kyoka, Hikokiyo, and Kurumi. Keep the full names and relationships at the points where the script reveals them.

entries.reading: こうじやま ひこまろ
entries.note: Speaks with matter-of-fact excitement about the rooftop sighting.

entries.reading: こうじやま きょうか
entries.note: Gently asks the children to keep quiet and let the spectacle play out.
